original_target.title: Bolthausen–Sznitman ancestry for a fixed-size selected population

verification: Literature and theorem-scope review; no independent whole-proof or Lean verification.
scope_comparison: Original exact-size binary Brownian branching with kill-leftmost, equilibrium offset law, one common c(log N)^3 clock and all fixed sample/time-window finite-dimensional partition limits. Legrand–Maillard v4 §2.6 still describes coalescent genealogy as an expected extension of their displacement result. Absorbed drifting BBM with fluctuating population and exponential-offspring discrete models are different processes; spatial-profile and position-fluctuation limits do not preserve ancestry. Bounded current searches found no full match; not a certification of openness.
